node.title: Strict A=3 slope-slack rational-normal ledger
node.statement: At the official strict budget B=2^39, every live A=3 moving-kernel branch with m=2^37 and m<=e<=floor((4m-1)/3) has a primitive apolar generator whose e+1 parameter coefficient forms are independent. Its projective kernel family is a degree-e rational normal curve of exact separation rank e+1. If T supported slopes violate the desired T<=4m cap and h=4e+1-T, then 0<=h<=4(e-m). The exact root-incidence matrix has rank e+1, product-code weight T(N-rho)+O=N(T-e)+C, capacity deficit C=4e-rho+h*rho+O<=e+h*rho, at least max(0,N-e-h*rho) saturated domain rows, and at least T-(rho-3e) completely split generic columns. On h=0, the complete domain norm has a residual factor of degree at most e, at least N-e rows admit an exact complementary factorization, and every geometric component bidegree lies in a unique necessary arithmetic chamber. The former endpoint is exactly e=m,h=0. No residual stratum is excluded.
